description: Monthly revenue, costs, profit, margin and break-even for a residential cleaning business, from the number of clients, how often they are cleaned and the average price. Use for "how much does a cleaning business make" or "is my cleaning business profitable". Unset costs use typical small-business numbers.

averagePrice.description: Average price per visit, in dollars. Default 165.

clients.description: Recurring clients (or average clients served in a month).

fixedCostsMonthly.description: Insurance, software, vehicle, marketing and office per month, in dollars. Default about $1,060.

laborPct.description: Cleaner wages and payroll taxes, percent of revenue. Default 50.

visitsPerClientPerMonth.description: Visits per client per month: weekly 4.33, every 2 weeks 2.17, every 4 weeks 1. Default 2.17.

title: Cleaning business profit calculator
